name: Nucleus Rogue
description: Embark on a subatomic survival odyssey in NUCLEUS ROGUE, a scientifically-grounded roguelike powered by real-world nuclear data. Navigate a volatile particle grid, manage core stability, and harness radioactive decays as tactical tools to evolve through the Chart of Nuclides. Master deep atomic phenomena and push the boundaries of matter in this polished, atmospheric journey to the ultimate limits of the periodic table.
